subject: Request: keep-onboarding-active (procurement delay)
messages:
From: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@medinova.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Susan Park <susan.park@medinova.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: onboarding timeline + PO update

Hey Karthik —

Quick note from procurement: our PO is in routing but Finance says it will take at least 10 business days to clear because the vendor onboarding questionnaire flagged an extra review. The demo environment and ramp resources from your side have been really helpful — we are mid-internal evaluation and the team needs continuous access.

Can Redwood extend our trial access or provide a short-term token bump while the PO clears? If possible we’d like ~3 weeks so we can finish the evaluation and lock in the SOW. Attaching the latest SOW for context.

Sorry for the awkward timing — appreciate any flexibility.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Hsu
Director of Clinical AI
Medinova Health

Attachment: Medinova_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 215KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hsu <tom.hsu@medinova.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: onboarding timeline + PO update

Tom —

Thanks for the heads up and for sharing the SOW. Totally understand — procurement routing can be painful. We can do two things immediately to keep your pilots from stalling:

- Grant a provisional token cushion (200k tokens) to keep the sandbox live for up to 14 calendar days,
- And open a short trial extension for +14 days on top of the cushion, conditional on PO being submitted within that window.

Before I action this, I need a quick confirm that the PO number will be submitted, and who in your team owns the submission (Finance contact). We also need to flag this as a one-time concession for our internal audit. If you confirm, I’ll loop in Vanessa to approve the temporary credit and Ben for billing notes.

If procurement timeline looks longer than 14 days, tell me the expected clearance date and we’ll escalate.

- Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval request: provisional 21-day trial shield for Medinova (procurement delay)

Vanessa / Ben —

Context: Medinova (deal MDV-2027-134) reports procurement routing that will delay PO clearance. External asks for uninterrupted access to finish evaluation; they will submit the PO by 2027-06-09. I proposed a provisional cushion +14 days but the customer is requesting 21 days to be safe.

Proposal for internal approval (one-time concession):
- Grant a provisional token credit: 300,000 tokens (sandbox only), active immediately
- Trial extension window: 21 calendar days from approval (2027-06-02 to 2027-06-23)
- Conditions: PO number to be supplied by 2027-06-10 and full commercial terms to be signed within 30 days of PO issuance. If PO is not submitted by cutoff, tokens will be revoked and usage billable.

Customer benefit: prevents evaluation drop-off and preserves momentum for a >$200k TCV opportunity.
Risk notes: flags to finance/audit but low expected exposure due to limited token count and sandbox-only scope.

If you approve, I’ll send a short confirmation email to Tom/Susan and attach a DocuSign acknowledgment for their signature (link below).

DocuSign prep: https://www.docusign.com/tx/ABCD-1234
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/MDV-2027-134

Thanks — need a yes/no by EOD so we don’t interrupt demos tomorrow.

- Karthik
